name: Boon: Circle of Healing

description.content: Bless a Dull or Hex Totem to create a Boon Totem with a [24m] range.

items: Heal others [100%] faster without a Med-Kit.
While injured, other Survivors see their Aura.

quote: "Try this, it's better than anything you'll find in a pharmacy." -Mikaela Reid
